research_scope: Scientific assessment of the Meridian System; not validation of a cultural tradition as a whole and not clinical treatment advice.
validated_findings: Acupuncture can show modest condition-specific effects in some chronic-pain trial contexts.
Acupuncture for migraine prevention has a legitimate controlled-outcome evidence base.
Local impedance and connective-tissue associations are heterogeneous and can be confounded by ordinary anatomy.
Candidate neural, autonomic, immune, and tissue mechanisms are not equivalent to proof of a separate meridian system.
required_invariants: The idea must distinguish clinical effect, local mechanism, and meridian ontology.
The idea must include anatomically matched and spatially controlled comparators.
The idea must specify a result that would weaken or falsify the meridian-specific account.
No candidate may claim that an interstitial-space interpretation is already proven.
